summary: Corrected pilot-only soft-screen kNN grid (weights after scaling)
reasoning: Batch 4's flat rows exposed the order bug: StandardScaler after SoftScreen cancels per-feature weights (std scales with w). Corrected pipeline: StandardScaler -> SoftScreen(F^alpha on training fold, top-K) -> kNN(manhattan, distance). Same grid K {20,30,40,50} x alpha {0,0.5,1,2} x nn {7,11,15}, 10 pilot CV folds. Sanity: alpha=0 must reproduce ~0.716 at K=20 nn=11. Bar: soft configs >= ~0.74.
